Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at a location that has no inactive parts at all, such as a newly created location.
    • How to do it: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Locations in the left menu, then New Location; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425591 LOCATION NEW in Name * and click Save & Close. To switch to it: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it.
  • Create an active part, part A, at that location for this test.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425591 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425591-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, then click Save.
  • Start on that location's Inventory page, on the Active tab, with the Search box empty and Bin Location and Category set to All.
